target.meter: 4/4 half-time feel; Bridge may rubato one bar
target.key_strategy: A minor verses, F major-leaning chorus, C major outro

lead_voice.timbre: deadpan ceremonial broadcast, flat even pitch, zero breathiness, zero intimacy; verses flat solo, choruses processional unison choir
lead_voice.narrative_role: automated tide-archive choir voice; ocean is the subject, humans are guests; never a lover, mermaid, saint, or preacher

sound_world: hauntological analog electronics: sine drones, Mellotron choir tapes, Ondes Martenot glissandi, tape wow and flutter, sonar pulse, shortwave drift, hydrophone textures, spring reverb; mid-distance dry vocal, short plate tail

hook.strategy: same words, changed color: from nostalgia to holding-on

diction_notes.chandelier: three syllables, stress the last, lift upward
diction_notes.cathedral: slow, long middle vowel in Bridge
diction_notes.plastic: the only dry, plainly articulated word

rhyme_design.verse_pattern: XAXA: lines 2 and 4 full rhyme, lines 1 and 3 free; free lines carry the strangest surreal images
rhyme_design.pre_chorus_pattern: slant rhyme: sent/breath, same vowel, different final consonant
rhyme_design.chorus_pattern: ABAB: names/frames full rhyme, dreaming/leaving near rhyme, closing hands/again couplet intentionally unrhymed
rhyme_design.bridge_outro_pattern: unrhymed; rhyme dissolves as the truth is revealed
rhyme_design.strategy: mixed strict rhyme, slant rhyme, and free rhyme; never bend words to force a rhyme

motif.name: water motif
motif.outro: resolve upward to C, then dissolve

short_edit.strategy: crop first; if needed regenerate without the Chorus 2 repetition and Intro vocalise
short_edit.allowed_cut: remove the Chorus 2 repetition only; all other lines remain frozen
short_edit.style_additions: compact two-minute form, starts on first vocal line, no instrumental intro, no instrumental break, no extended outro
short_edit.exclude_additions: long intro, instrumental break, extended outro, repeated chorus
